mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, passport_uuid, passport_name, passport_email, passport_phone, username, password_hash, real_name, email, phone, avatar_key, dept_id, status, last_login_ip, last_login_time, sort_order, create_by, update_by, firm_id, create_time, update_time FROM user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND BINARY username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, tenant_id, username, password_hash, real_name, email, phone, status FROM user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND email = #{email} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM user WHERE email = #{email} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.perm_id = p.id INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0
SELECT r.role_code, r.role_name FROM role r INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET last_login_ip = #{lastLoginIp}, last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id FROM user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
